title: Poise Tauri IPC Events
description: Events emitted from src-tauri via AppHandle::emit and consumed in the frontend via @tauri-apps/api/event's listen().

sidecar-status.description: Pushed whenever the sidecar's health-check loop observes a state change. See src-tauri/src/sidecar.rs and frontend/src/lib/ipc.ts (onSidecarStatusChange).
